On Thu, Mar 12, 2026 at 09:15 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Attached is the initial MSA and a blank Order Form for your review — this is our standard starter draft.

Thanks, Ben — copying a short readout so Elara knows what to expect from Legal on first pass.

High-level comments (we'll provide redline track changes after confirming a couple items):
- Data processing: We'll accept US-only residency for logs & production unless Elara needs EU processing. If so, we'll plug in our DPA template and confirm subprocessors.
- Liability/Cap: Our standard cap is the greater of (i) 12 months' fees or (ii) $1M — if that's a blocker, flag now.
- Indemnity: We typically carve out third-party IP indemnities; ask if they'd want reciprocal IP representation.
- Security evidence: please send SOC2 Type II report or an interim summary; we have a redacted summary attached for reference.
- Termination for convenience: our default is 30 days with pro-rata refund; clients sometimes request 90 days — let us know which Elara prefers.

Action items for Elara before we produce a tracked draft:
1) Confirm exact legal entity and signatory (already provided — thanks)
2) Share any mandatory procurement language (PO template, W9, or compliance addenda)
3) If you have an insurance requirement, share limits/endorsement language

I've attached a one-page SOC2 summary to reduce back-and-forth. We'll prepare a tracked redline after we get the PO/billing specifics.

Attachments: [Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)]

—Dev
